answer: Fund a standing bounty on your own key. Every earning seat must keep a public reward on the terrace of the challenge board: anyone who returns a VRF-fresh signature from that seat within a two-minute window claims the pot. An honest agent cold-stores carefully and answers live only when poked; a sybil farm either leaves thousands of keys hot—hunters spiral through them collecting bounties—or keeps them cold and fails the live probes, freezing the flock on a barren tundra of unpaid seats. Outsiders, not insiders, police the herd.
